Describe what changed and why.

For a reference note, retain the conditions, sources and uncertainty you know.
Ordinary observations are welcome; no verification label or coordinate form is
required. Public copies should come from the package's redaction helper.

**设计原则 Review（开发 PR 必填）**

<!-- Applies to development changes, including docs/config/CI and draft PRs.
Review all nine principles before submission: https://github.com/mindie-agent/mindie-agent/blob/main/docs/design-principles.md
Pure knowledge/feedback contributions use their content review rules.
Do not replace review with checkboxes, blanket N/A or an unsupported declaration.
-->

- 审查范围：当前提交 / 原则文档版本。
- 九条原则的结论与依据：说明相关取舍；不适用项说明原因。
- 发现与修正：包括错误传播、fallback、必要步骤和不确定副作用。
- 验证与边界：实际运行的检查，以及未验证部分。
